skill.summary: AI-powered context management for OpenClaw sessions

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Context Manager skill for OpenClaw.
- Provides AI-powered session summarization and context compression using agent self-analysis.
- Adds session listing, status checking, safe summarization, and destructive compression/reset commands.
- Backs up and resets session files, injecting AI-generated summaries to maintain focused context.
- Includes comprehensive CLI support, configuration options, troubleshooting steps, and best practices.
